\section{Limitations}

Our study has several limitations that qualify the scope of the conclusions.

\textbf{Simulation only.} All experiments use simulated single-arm tabletop tasks; real-robot transfer is untested. Sim-to-real gaps in dynamics, perception noise, and contact modeling may alter the relative safety ranking of conditions. \textbf{Single model and benchmark.} We study one architecture (OpenVLA-7B with LoRA) on one benchmark (SafeLIBERO Level~I). The factorial effects---particularly the BN running-statistics mechanism---may differ for other VLA families, model scales, or safety benchmarks with different collision definitions. Extending to multiple architectures and benchmarks would strengthen generalizability.

Non-hyperparameter implementation details can dominate the signal of interest; our quantitative conclusions may not transfer across codebases without re-verification.

Additional limitations: all conditions use LoRA; effects under full fine-tuning are untested. Content and temporal ablations were conducted under the original codebase only.
